scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @surreal/shared && npm run dev -w api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @surreal/shared && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @surreal/shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @surreal/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
